notes: Each downloaded guide prints its CVIG BT code on the cover and sample ballot. Fine GIS ballot_type references are retained as evidence only, not accepted as aliases.
PDF sample cards span paired cropped pages. The embedded full-card text repeats across each pair; extraction selects each full card once and stops at the printing Count marker.
Candidate sets, party preferences, designations, vote limits, six Fifth District judicial names, 14 statewide propositions, and local measure text are checked across every style.
Livingston City Clerk and City Treasurer short-term contests have only a write-in line; no candidate names are invented.
